title: Fix-Ids Payload Schema
description: Output shape of `qdev validate --fix-ids --json`. This branch of `qdev validate` emits a renumber report rather than a finding list, so it has its own schema; the `validate` payload covers the plain branch. Schema changes follow semver on schema_version; additive fields do not bump the major.

renumbered.description: One entry per file whose frontmatter id was rewritten.

old_path.description: Workspace-relative path the renumbered file had before the renumber.

new_path.description: Workspace-relative path the renumbered file has after the renumber. A renumber renames the file so its name carries new_id (any '-slug'/'_slug' suffix is preserved), keeping it resolvable by the write path; reporting both paths keeps the git-visible move from being silent. Equal to old_path only when the name already carried new_id.

old_id.description: The duplicated id, which the group's first file keeps.

new_id.description: The freshly allocated id this file now declares.

relations_rewritten.description: Source entity ids whose relations were redirected from old_id to new_id. Note that the group's first file keeps old_id, so an edge that meant the keeper is redirected away from it; nothing records which of the colliding files a reference meant.

citations_rewritten.description: How many citation occurrences under the configured module globs were redirected from old_id to new_id.

skipped.description: Workspace-relative paths that were offered a renumber and not rewritten (declined at the prompt, or an unparseable id).
